title: A medida que: procesos que avanzan juntos

sections.content: A medida que (as, to the extent that) links two processes advancing in step -- exactly the shape this closing synthesis needs, since institutional strengthening, cultural nationalism, education, and territorial integration weren't separate stories but one gradual, mutually reinforcing change. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A medida que avanzaban las primeras décadas del siglo veinte, el propio significado de la palabra "Estado" fue transformándose.
items.english: As the early decades of the twentieth century went by, the very meaning of the word "state" kept transforming.

items.spanish: A medida que se profesionalizaban los ejércitos y crecía la presencia burocrática cotidiana, el Estado dejaba de depender de la lealtad personal hacia un caudillo.
items.english: As armies were professionalized and everyday bureaucratic presence grew, the state stopped depending on personal loyalty to a caudillo.

items.spanish: A medida que este proceso avanzaba, también lo hacía un proyecto cultural paralelo destinado a dar sentido simbólico al Estado.
items.english: As this process advanced, so did a parallel cultural project meant to give the state symbolic meaning.

items.spanish: A medida que la escuela, el censo y el servicio militar alcanzaban regiones cada vez más remotas, la experiencia de ser ciudadano se volvía más concreta.
items.english: As school, the census, and military service reached ever more remote regions, the experience of being a citizen became more concrete.

sections.content: También lo hacía ("so did...") is a compact way to say a second process kept pace with the first without repeating the verb -- lo replaces the whole action just mentioned, much like English "so did it."
